brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail as a PNG, landscape 1920x1080, approximately 16:9. This is a new artwork for the article "11/17 試合結果・当日のEFF". Follow the visual language of the black-and-lime approved illustration visible in this conversation: near-black #151A18 background, sharp lime #CCF43B brush strokes, bold Japanese typography, expressive hand-drawn ink and dry-brush crosshatching, ivory highlights. Clearly an illustration, never a photograph or photorealistic rendering.

PERSON: Exactly one real basketball player, Ryota Kobayashi (小林遥太), randomly selected from names in the supplied article. Use the official profile portrait visible in this conversation as a likeness reference ONLY. Draw him from scratch in ink; do not paste or copy the photograph. He has straight black medium-short hair parted near the middle with softly curved curtains exposing the center of his forehead, sides resting just above the ears, a clean-shaven face, gently angular oval jaw and compact chin, fairly straight dark eyebrows, narrow almond-shaped dark eyes, a straight nose with rounded tip, thin upper lip and fuller lower lip. Retain his recognizable facial proportions and mature adult appearance, athletic compact guard build. Not a generic or fictional player. Plain dark basketball uniform with ivory/lime edging, no lettering, no logos, no sponsor marks, no jersey number. Face must be lit and readable in ivory/gray ink tones, not lost in black shadow.

SCENE AND COMPOSITION: Dynamic low dribbling pose on the LEFT 43% of the canvas, torso leaning forward diagonally, both knees flexed, right hand controlling a single orange basketball low to the left and his left arm naturally bent for balance. Three-quarter view of face looking toward open space on the right, anatomically credible shoulders, wrists, hands and fingers. Keep head, ball, both hands and fingers fully within the frame with generous margins. Crop below the knees only if needed. A few sweeping lime ink strokes imply lateral motion, with minimal court marks. No other people. This is a general imagined basketball illustration, NOT a recreation of the 11/17 match, NOT any decisive scoring play.

TYPOGRAPHY on RIGHT 55%, crisp Japanese heavy Gothic, clean shapes with lightly distressed ink edges. All text stays safely within frame, at least 5% away from canvas edges. Very high contrast. Exact visible text ONLY, without quotation marks:
Top small white: 「バスケまとめ」
Below medium ivory: 「11/17 試合結果」
Main enormous headline, two lines if necessary: 「当日の」 then 「EFF」, with EFF in lime.
Below main headline, clearly readable medium white: 「リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3」
Footer small but legible, high-contrast white on quiet black: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」

CONSTRAINTS: No player name in the artwork. No individual statistics, player ranking, claims of participation or performance, team score, club name or match-specific action. TOP3 is the article section, grouped by league and registered position; it must never read as a rank assigned to the pictured player. Do not use any text, statistics or names from the approved style reference. No team or league logos, no official photographs, no sponsor marks, no extra captions. Preserve the exact full-width parentheses in イラスト（AI生成）. Simplicity, forceful editorial hierarchy, a clearly recognizable real person, physically coherent dribbling action, polished final thumbnail.


ONE CORRECTIVE EDIT
Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit.
Make ONE corrective revision to the first attached image, the finished basketball illustration thumbnail. The second attached image is the official portrait of the real player Ryota Kobayashi, for likeness reference only; never paste the photo into the artwork.

Preserve the entire approved black #151A18 / lime #CCF43B ink-brush illustration language, orange ball, overall left-player/right-type concept, exact text, and near-16:9 landscape canvas (at least 1600 pixels wide). This remains a hand-drawn editorial illustration and an imagined generic dribble, not an actual game photograph or an event reconstruction.

Correct these observed QA issues:
1. Recompose with generous safe margins. Reduce the player and ball together to about 86% of their current size and shift them slightly RIGHT and DOWN so the full top of the hair has at least 55 pixels of clear black margin and the ENTIRE ball and ALL fingers on both hands have at least 55 pixels of clear space from every edge. Show the same low athletic dribble, realistic joints and five fingers per hand, face readable, no ball/hand clipping. Lower legs may exit the bottom; head, hands and ball may NOT. Keep typography within 60-pixel safe margins on all sides; reduce the longest subheading slightly if necessary.
2. Match Kobayashi's actual face and hair more closely to reference 2: straight black, short-to-medium curtain hair parted close to the middle, much LESS wavy and less voluminous than the first illustration, exposed center forehead. Mature adult, clean-shaven. Slightly broader mid-face and compact straight jaw with rounded-square chin, fairly small narrow almond eyes, straighter eyebrows and natural nose/lip shapes as in reference 2. Keep likeness and body wholly rendered as ink drawing; preserve his athletic guard physique. Do not turn him into a generic youthful anime character.

Keep uniform entirely plain: no number, letters, sponsor, team mark or logo.
Exact visible text, unchanged:
バスケまとめ
11/17 試合結果
当日の
EFF
リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

No name, personal result, player ranking, team score, or any additional words. The labels describe the article, never a claim that this randomly chosen player was the day's best performer. Keep the two AI/imagination footer labels clearly readable. Produce one complete revised PNG.
